historical_references.reference: Al-Mizan, a biographical and bibliographical dictionary by Ibn Abd al-Barr, includes an entry on Nattaj ibn Amr al-Himyari, a notable Sufi master and scholar from Yemen who lived during the end of the 11th and the beginning of the 12th century. He was a disciple of Imam Al-Haddad and was known for his wisdom, piety, and asceticism.
